schema.description: Combination layer: intersection of the alternate-regime degree sweep (alt_inf_sweep.json) with the finite-place valuation lemmas of ALT_REGIME.md and ALT_REGIME_L2.md, over the 27 open flipped branches.
inputs: ALT_REGIME_L2.md (h6/h5 order cones sec.2, residual normal form sec.5)
schema.mechanism: deg d1 >= sum_P v_P(d1) = X, deg sigma >= sum_P v_P(sigma) = Z (orders at distinct places add); a state dies iff no admissible per-place cone selection meets X<=deg d1 and Z<=deg sigma (T1), resp. Z<=deg sigma (T2).

citations.T1_t: ALT_REGIME_L2.md sec.2 [C] T1 t-row (h6/h5 order cone) + ALT_REGIME.md 'Terminal plus first-level local lemmas' (T1 anchor 2 v_t(d1)>=w, odd-s parity, h7=8192 d1^2)
citations.T1_q: ALT_REGIME_L2.md sec.2 [C] T1 q-row (h6/h5 order cone) + ALT_REGIME.md T1 q-terminal (3b_i+v_i(g_7)=7+2v_i(d1))
citations.T2_t: ALT_REGIME.md 'Terminal plus first-level local lemmas' T2 (v_t(sigma)>=w) + ALT_REGIME_L2.md sec.2 (O2), sigma^2 terminal
citations.T2_q: ALT_REGIME.md T2 q-lemmas (b=1:z>=2; b=2 impossible; b=3:z=7; b=4 impossible) + ALT_REGIME_L2.md sec.2 (O2)
citations.L2_R: ALT_REGIME_L2.md sec.5 (R0)/(R1)/(R2) residual normal form (deg d1>=X, deg sigma>=Z, X<=9, Z<=12, deg F<=15-a-sum b)
